review_notes: Reviewed all 93 lines, the energy and window definitions, supporting bounds, and downstream uses. One generalisation is justified for the combinatorial helper; the analytic theorem's specialisations are supported by its dependencies. Proposed changes were not tested in Lean.

findings.excerpt:
theorem sum_selected_cells_le_overlap {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset κ) (J : κ → Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ i, ((S.filter (fun k => i ∈ J k)).card : ℝ) ≤ K) :
    (∑ k ∈ S, ∑ i ∈ J k, w i) ≤ K*∑ i, w i := by
findings.problem: This weighted incidence bound is restricted to real weights although its proof uses only semiring identities and monotonicity. Consequently, natural-number or rational weighted counting applications must first cast their data to ℝ.
findings.proposed_change:
Generalise the statement to:

 theorem sum_selected_cells_le_overlap {ι κ R : Type*}
     [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R]
     (S : Finset κ) (J : κ → Finset ι) (w : ι → R) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
     (K : R) (hK : ∀ i, ((S.filter (fun k => i ∈ J k)).card : R) ≤ K) :
     (∑ k ∈ S, ∑ i ∈ J k, w i) ≤ K * ∑ i, w i

The existing proof strategy applies after replacing its explicit ℝ annotations by R: interchange finite sums, express each multiplicity using sum_const and nsmul_eq_mul, then apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right and sum_le_sum. IsOrderedRing supplies the required addition and multiplication monotonicity. Empty index types and empty selections remain covered; no positivity assumption on K or nontriviality assumption on R is needed. The existing real-valued call infers R from w.
findings.benefit: Makes the same elementary overlap estimate directly usable for integer counts and rational weights without changing its real-valued application or adding substantial abstraction.

class IsOrderedRing (R : Type*) [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] extends
    IsOrderedAddMonoid R, ZeroLEOneClass R, PosMulMono R, MulPosMono R where

@[simp] lemma nsmul_eq_mul (n : ℕ) (a : α) : n • a = n * a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_nsmul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  | succ n ih => rw [succ_nsmul, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]

theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right [MulPosMono α] (hbc : b ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : b * a ≤ c * a :=
  MulPosMono.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hbc

lemma mul_sum (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R) :
    a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i := map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a) _ s
